title: Match an invoice, assembled
sub: Read the invoice into fixed fields, then let code run the join: quantity, price and total against the purchase order and what was received.

steps.d:
"Corrigan Fasteners, Invoice #INV-77012, PO Number: PO-4410,
FST-2201 qty 40 @ $12.50, FST-2209 qty 40 @ $6.40,
Total due: $756.00"

steps.h: Your code asks the model for the fixed fields
steps.d:
supplier, po_number, invoice_number, currency,
line items (code, quantity, unit price in cents), stated total
PO-4410: found, Corrigan Fasteners, USD, 2 lines

steps.h: Your code runs the three subtractions
steps.d:
FST-2201: invoiced 40, received 40, $12.50 ordered
FST-2209: invoiced 40, received 40, $6.40 ordered
invoice states $756.00, its own lines sum to $756.00

steps.h: Your code checks the gate: everything reconciles
steps.d:
no discrepancies
(the pause to accounts payable, below, was not taken this run)

steps.h: A different invoice pauses here instead
steps.d:
example: FST-2201 invoiced at $12.51 against a $12.50 order,
reason=mismatch, +1 cent on one line
(the direct pass-through to Posted, above, was not taken on that run)

steps.h: The AP clerk reviews the paused match and decides
steps.d:
sees: the invoice, the purchase order, the discrepancy in cents
decides: reject, and asks the supplier for a corrected invoice

steps.h: Your code resumes and posts, or sends the invoice back
steps.d: this run: posted PO-4410 / INV-77012, $756.00 to accounts payable
